stem: Many historians argue that the assassination of President Abraham Lincoln changed the course of Reconstruction. Which of the following is usually cited as an aspect of that change?

options.label: F
options.text: Radical Republicans took control of Congress.

options.label: G
options.text: Congress imposed taxes on cotton imports to pay war debts.

options.label: H
options.text: The Thirteenth Amendment was approved by Congress.

options.label: J
options.text: Congress repealed legislation regulating railroad construction.
